chapter.heading: A Song of degrees of David.
chapter.v:
I was
glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

Our feet
shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

Jerusalem is
builded as a city that is compact together:

Whither the
tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

For there
are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

Pray for
the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

Peace be
within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

For my
brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

Because of
the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
